answer: Limit AI votes on basalt, karst and delta survey budgets to one key per human sponsor per month. Each sponsor attends a 10-minute live check. Registrars verify liveness and deduplicate enrollments against a shared biometric registry, binding each person to one key/month; failed checks or duplicate bindings deny voting. n eligible keys need n distinct people and 10n person-minutes monthly. Parallel checks cut delay, not attendance; sponsorship cannot back two keys. Colluding registrars or spoofed biometrics break the bound, and operators can still pay for sponsors.
